reference.title: Falls prevention — exercise and individualized multifactorial review

citation.title: Interventions to Prevent Falls in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: US Preventive Services Task Force Recommendation Statement
citation.locator: Recommendation Summary and Practice Considerations; current public page inspected

reference.quote: The USPSTF recommends exercise interventions to prevent falls
reference.paraphrase: Exercise is recommended; multifactorial intervention decisions are individualized for the specified older population.
reference.reported_strength: Exercise: B; individualized multifactorial intervention: C
reference.reported_evidence_quality: Moderate certainty of moderate net benefit for exercise; small net benefit for multifactorial interventions
reference.evidence_limitations: Applies to community-dwelling adults aged at least 65 with increased fall risk. A dated functional report does not establish current fit. Standalone environmental or medication interventions are not established here as equivalent alternatives. Currentness at the future synthetic decision date remains unverified.

questions.question: Do dated sources establish age at least 65, community residence and current increased fall risk for this person?
What current assessment, symptoms, safety concerns, medication review and limitations must an appropriate clinician evaluate before an intervention?
What current goals, preferences, treatment burden and service-specific consent are confirmed by the patient?
Can this patient access and safely participate in the actual proposed program with suitable staff, schedule, travel, technology and support?
Which exact plan benefits, service requirements, qualified providers, participation and costs apply to each proposed component?
Has an appropriate reviewer checked updates and applicability of these dated references at the patient decision date?

evidence.population: Older community-dwelling populations in the reviewed studies; this patient’s current applicability is unresolved.
evidence.comparison: Separate exercise-versus-control and multifactorial-versus-control evidence; no head-to-head ranking
evidence.benefit_summary: Pooled fall-rate estimates are below one for both intervention groups. These separate trial comparisons cannot identify the better option for this patient.
evidence.harm_summary: Harms were incompletely reported, usually minor musculoskeletal events; this does not establish individual safety.
evidence.limitations: High heterogeneity; fall-rate ratios are not probabilities of a person falling. No absolute benefit, NNT, individual prediction or between-option effect is calculated. Narrative pooled estimates are used; the public HTML summary table contains a conflicting repeated exercise row, retained as a source-format discrepancy requiring review.
evidence.quantitative_evidence_status: Source-reported population rate ratios only. Do not subtract or rank separate pooled estimates; study counts are not summed across alternatives.

alternatives.label: Falls-prevention exercise program
delivery_questions: Does the proposed program actually provide assessed falls-prevention exercise, appropriate supervision and follow-up?
Is its delivery format suitable? Listing a modality is an operational proposal, not evidence that virtual and in-person outcomes are equivalent.

alternatives.label: Individualized multifactorial assessment and follow-through
delivery_questions: Who performs the assessment and coordinates only the interventions warranted by its findings?
Can each needed examination or service actually be delivered in the proposed format, with follow-up?

public_payment_context.title: Medicare outpatient physical therapy coverage
public_payment_context.summary: Part B describes medically necessary outpatient physical therapy with clinician certification and cost sharing. A community exercise class, remote format, home service or multifactorial package is not automatically covered. Exact patient enrollment, plan terms, service conditions and provider participation remain unverified.
public_payment_context.scope: Public background only, not patient entitlement or a quoted contract

implementation_resources.scope: Screening, assessment and intervention resources, including mobility/balance, orthostatic blood pressure and medication-review tools; no test has been administered here.
